title: Best Microwave Under ₹15,000 in India (2026): Convection Picks
description: We compared 7 microwaves under ₹15,000 — LG, Samsung, IFB, Panasonic. Convection vs grill, Indian auto-cook menus, magnetron warranty. 4 picks + 1 skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a microwave under ₹15,000
Solo vs grill vs convection: what you actually need

cta.headline: Want to bake AND reheat?
cta.sub: A convection microwave does it all. We ranked each model for Indian cooking, daily use, and reliability under ₹15,000.

faq.a: Single/couple: 17-20L. Family of 3-4: 20-23L. Family of 5+: 23-25L. Joint family (7+): 28L+. Most Indian families of 3-4 should pick 20-23L.
OTG is dedicated to baking (better for serious bakers). Convection microwave does everything (reheat, cook, grill, bake). For all-in-one: convection microwave. For dedicated baking: OTG.

faq.q: How long does a microwave last?
faq.a: 8-10 years for LG/Samsung/IFB. 5-8 years for cheaper brands. Magnetron is the failure point after 7-8 years. Look for 3-5 year magnetron warranty.
NO. Never put metal in a microwave — it sparks and damages the magnetron. Use microwave-safe glass, ceramic, or labeled microwave-safe plastic.
Inverter microwaves (Panasonic, some LG) use variable power for even cooking. Result: even cooking, faster defrost, lighter weight. Worth it for frequent users.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the LG 20L Convection Microwave (MC2146BP). 151 Indian auto-cook menus (most in this range), Intellowave even cooking, 4-year magnetron warranty, LG service network across India. The benchmark for sub-₹15,000 convection in Indian homes.
key_takeaways: Convection is the right type for Indian cooking (reheat + grill + bake).
20L is right for families of 3-4; 23L+ for 5+ family members.
100+ Indian auto-cook menus save real time (dal, rice, curry, idli).
3+ year magnetron warranty is non-negotiable at this price.
who_for: Indian families who want a versatile all-in-one for reheating, Indian cooking, grilling, and baking. Ideal for working professionals who rely on reheating, families who want tandoori/grilled food without a separate grill, and home bakers who want basic cake/bread baking capability.
methodology: We compared 7 microwaves available on Amazon India, Flipkart, and brand stores under ₹15,000. For each, we evaluated capacity, type (solo/grill/convection), wattage, auto-cook menu count and Indian-specific tuning, magnetron warranty, and service network. Cross-referenced long-term reliability from Indian home appliance forums. Reviewed every 60 days.
